abstract: I study the potential for collusion before and after the American Airlines‐US Airways merger. Results suggest the merger increased major airlines' incentives to coordinate their pricing decisions. US Airways was disinclined to collude prior to the merger due to its unique route structure which was highly dependent on connecting products. The merger, by combining the networks of US Airways and American Airlines, reduced US Airways' dependence on connecting products and enhanced its incentives to collude. Absent US Airways' unique premerger network structure, the merger would not have substantially increased major airlines' incentives to collude.
abstract_zh: 我研究了美国航空与全美航空合并前后共谋的可能性。结果表明，合并增强了主要航空公司协调定价决策的动机。合并前，全美航空因其独特的航线结构，高度依赖中转产品，而不倾向于共谋。合并通过整合全美航空与美国航空的网络，降低了全美航空对中转产品的依赖，并增强了其共谋动机。若无全美航空合并前独特的网络结构，该合并不会显著增强主要航空公司的共谋动机。
title: Coordinated Effects in the American Airlines‐US Airways Merger
title_zh: 美国航空与美国航空集团合并中的协调效应

abstract: Consider a population of agents who repeatedly compete for awards, as in the case of researchers annually applying for grants. Noise in the selection process may encourage entry of low quality proposals, forcing the principal to commit large resources to reviewing applications and further increasing award misallocation. A \emph{temporary exclusion} policy prohibits an agent from applying in the current period if they were rejected in the previous. We compare the steady state equilibria of the games with and without exclusion. Whenever the benefit from winning is sufficiently large exclusion results in more self-selection, eliminating entry of low quality applications. We extend the analysis to more general exclusion policies. We also show that exclusion has a distributional effect, where better able agents exhibit more self-selection.
abstract_zh: 考虑一群代理人反复竞争奖项的情形，例如研究人员每年申请资助的情况。评选过程中的噪音可能鼓励低质量提案的进入，迫使委托方投入大量资源审查申请，并进一步加剧奖项分配不当。一项临时排除政策规定，若代理人在上一期获得低评价，则禁止其在本期申请。我们研究了此类政策下各种情形的稳态均衡。在排除政策下，拥有低质量申请的代理人会选择自行退出，从而减少提交量并缓解奖项分配不当。同时，由于被禁止代理人的资格受限，高质量申请的数量也会减少。我们还表明，排除政策具有分配效应，其中能力较高的代理人表现出更多的自我选择行为。
title: Temporary exclusion in repeated contests
title_zh: 重复竞赛中的临时排除

abstract: We examine cooperation and defection in populations where individuals use both procedural rationality and imitation to choose their strategies. For a broad class of sampling-based choice procedures that encompasses both procedural rationality and imitation, we characterize the conditions under which universal defection is unstable. The results highlight that for cooperation to emerge and persist, the manner in which agents generate and share information can be as important as the underlying payoff incentives.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在个体同时运用程序理性与模仿来选择策略的群体中的合作与背叛行为。针对一类广泛的基于抽样的选择程序，该程序涵盖了程序理性与模仿，我们刻画了普遍背叛不稳定的条件。结果表明，要使合作得以涌现并持续，代理人生成和分享信息的方式可能与潜在的收益激励同样重要。
title: Procedural rationality, endogenous sampling, and the instability of defection
title_zh: 程序理性、内生抽样与背叛的不稳定性

abstract: In recent decades, the U.S. economy has experienced a rise in market power, a slowdown in productivity growth, and a pronounced increase in wealth concentration. We develop a theory in which a decline in competition jointly generates these developments. Reduced competition raises markups and firm valuations while weakening knowledge spillovers and slowing growth. Higher firm valuations put upward pressure on the return gap, (r-g), while slower growth allows the real interest rate to fall. The wider return gap changes saving behavior across the wealth distribution, increasing wealth concentration. To study this mechanism, we combine an endogenous-growth model with heterogeneous households and incomplete markets. Quantitatively, the model accounts for substantial parts of the observed rise in markups and wealth concentration and the decline in productivity growth, while also generating a fall in the real interest rate. Changes in saving behavior among the top 1 percent explain almost the entire rise in concentration. Finally, higher market power lowers welfare for most households while benefiting only the very top of the wealth distribution.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，美国经济经历了市场力量的增强、生产率增长的放缓以及财富集中度的显著上升。我们构建了一个理论，其中竞争减弱共同引发了这些发展。竞争减少提高了加成率和企业估值，同时削弱了知识溢出并减缓了增长。更高的企业估值对回报率差距（r-g）形成上行压力，而增长放缓则使实际利率得以下降。更宽的回报率差距改变了财富分布中的储蓄行为，加剧了财富集中。为研究这一机制，我们将内生增长模型与异质性家庭及不完全市场相结合。在定量上，该模型解释了观察到的加成率上升、财富集中度增加以及生产率增长下降的相当大部分，同时也能生成实际利率的下降。前1%人群储蓄行为的变化几乎解释了集中度上升的全部原因。最后，更高的市场力量降低了大多数家庭的福利，而仅惠及财富分布最顶端的群体。
title: Market power, growth, and wealth inequality
title_zh: 市场势力、增长与财富不平等

abstract: By institutionally rethinking the Solow residual in light of how the interplay of policy interventions and market forces affects factor income shares, we attempt to interpret China’s TFP performance from an institutional perspective. To explore the growth–efficiency paradox inherent in the China model of growth, we apply the Jorgensonian APPF–Domar growth accounting framework to the revised and updated CIP/China KLEMS dataset. The framework coherently integrates industry productivity accounts with national accounts to distinguish TFP growth caused by changes in factor utilization within industries from TFP growth caused by changes in factor reallocation between industries. By regrouping 37 Chinese industries according to their distance from state controls (or, conversely, their proximity to final demand) and dividing the entire 1978–2023 period into subperiods to reflect major policy and institutional changes and external shocks, we show that capital reallocation brought about strong TFP gains when both the government and the market happened to address similar structural problems, but policy efforts toward growth inevitably led to efficiency losses and ultimately hindered China’s growth.
abstract_zh: 通过从制度层面重新审视索洛剩余，并考量政策干预与市场力量相互作用如何影响要素收入份额，我们试图从制度视角解读中国的全要素生产率表现。为探究中国增长模式中固有的增长-效率悖论，我们将乔根森式APPF-多马增长核算框架应用于修订并更新的CIP/中国KLEMS数据集。该框架将行业生产率账户与国民账户有机整合，以区分行业内要素利用变化引起的全要素生产率增长与行业间要素重新配置变化引起的全要素生产率增长。通过根据37个中国行业与国家控制距离（或反之，与最终需求接近程度）进行重新分组，并将1978-2023年整个时期划分为子时期以反映重大政策与制度变迁及外部冲击，我们表明，当政府与市场恰好共同应对类似结构性问题时，资本重新配置带来了强劲的全要素生产率收益，但旨在促进增长的政策努力不可避免地导致效率损失，并最终阻碍了中国经济增长。

abstract: International trade in digital services, including mobile app trade (e.g., Facebook in Frankfurt, Instagram in Istanbul), is large and rapidly growing. Analyzing 2015–2020 data on 28,000 mobile apps, we find that AI increases an app’s user base threefold, a massive effect. AI’s handmaiden is data, including cross-border flows of personal data. Concerned with privacy and national security, policymakers have responded with thousands of conflicting data regulations, ranging from guaranteeing free trade in data (USMCA) to data export bans. We are the first to show that these regulations matter: AI’s massive effect is halved in countries with strict data flow restrictions.
abstract_zh: 包括移动应用贸易（如法兰克福的Facebook、伊斯坦布尔的Instagram）在内的数字服务国际贸易规模庞大且增长迅速。基于2015至2020年间28,000款移动应用的数据分析，我们发现人工智能使应用的用户基础扩大了三倍，这一效应极为显著。人工智能的辅助因素是数据，包括个人数据的跨境流动。出于隐私和国家安全的考量，政策制定者已出台数千项相互冲突的数据法规，从保障数据自由贸易（如USMCA）到禁止数据出口不等。我们率先证明这些法规具有实质影响：在数据流动限制严格的国家，人工智能的巨大效应减半。
title: The impact of AI and cross-border data regulation on international trade in digital services
title_zh: 人工智能与跨境数据监管对数字服务国际贸易的影响

abstract: This study examines the spatial treatment effects of Low-carbon City pilot policy on PM 2.5 concentrations across 277 cities in China from 2005 to 2023. Based on spatial causal inference, this study finds that this policy significantly decreases PM 2.5 concentrations in regions with greater policy intensity, while the direct effects of this policy are not significant in regions with lower policy intensity. Furthermore, the implementation of this policy reduces PM 2.5 concentrations in the neighbouring cities from the perspective of spatial effects while its direct effects are weaker. The implementation of Low-carbon City pilot policy diminishes PM 2.5 concentrations through increasing environmental technological innovation capacity and average green asset ratio of regional firms. This study further examines the spatial attenuation effects and heterogeneous impacts arising from differentiated policy regulation intensity, indicating the transformation of the spatial pattern from mutual collaboration to a beggar-thy-neighbour situation as distance increases. KEYWORDS: Environmental pilot policy spatial causal inference spillover effects spatial attenuation effects JEL CLASSIFICATION: C31 Q55 Q56 Acknowledgements The authors gratefully thank editors and three anonymous referees for their insightful feedback.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了低碳城市试点政策对2005年至2023年间中国277个城市PM 2.5浓度的空间处理效应。基于空间因果推断，本研究发现该政策在政策强度较高的地区显著降低了PM 2.5浓度，而在政策强度较低的地区，其直接效应并不显著。此外，从空间效应的角度来看，该政策的实施降低了邻近城市的PM 2.5浓度，而其直接效应则相对较弱。低碳城市试点政策的实施通过提升区域企业的环境技术创新能力和平均绿色资产比率来降低PM 2.5浓度。本研究进一步探讨了差异化政策调控强度所带来的空间衰减效应和异质性影响，表明随着距离的增加，空间格局从相互协作转变为以邻为壑的状态。关键词：环境试点政策 空间因果推断 溢出效应 空间衰减效应 JEL分类：C31 Q55 Q56 致谢 作者衷心感谢编辑及三位匿名审稿人的 insightful 反馈意见。

abstract: Focus How far can central banks shrink their balance sheets? The answer depends on the demand for central bank reserves and in particular on whether the drivers widely believed to have raised it over the past decade actually do. These drivers are: (i) post-Great Financial Crisis (GFC) liquidity regulation; (ii) the difficulty of monetising government bonds into reserves during stress; and (iii) the atrophy of interbank markets after years of abundant reserves. We ask whether these drivers really do shift reserve demand and what this implies for balance sheet normalisation.
abstract_zh: 焦点 中央银行能将资产负债表缩减到何种程度？答案取决于对央行准备金的需求，尤其是过去十年中被广泛认为推高这一需求的因素是否确实如此。这些因素包括：（一）后金融危机时期的流动性监管；（二）在压力时期将政府债券变现为准备金的难度；（三）多年准备金充裕后银行间市场的萎缩。我们探究这些因素是否真正改变了准备金需求，以及这对资产负债表正常化意味着什么。
title: Hard to shift, easy to reshape: central bank reserve demand and frictions
title_zh: 难以调整，易于重塑：央行储备需求与摩擦

abstract: We estimate the effect of the staggered adoption of carbon pricing policies across the globe between 1990 and 2017 on per capita $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions from fossil fuel combustion. We use recent econometric techniques robust to treatment effect heterogeneity. Our dynamic treatment effect estimations indicate gradual adjustments after implementation, resulting in a 19 to 23 percent decrease in $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions after 10 years. These effects were primarily driven by resource substitution rather than improvements in energy efficiency and were not driven by short-term responses to carbon prices. Our results are robust to controlling for the potential effects of renewable energy policies. These results highlight the role of carbon pricing policies in steering medium-term expectations and complementing the climate policy mix.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了1990年至2017年间全球范围内碳定价政策分阶段实施对化石燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳人均排放量的影响。我们采用了近期对处理效应异质性稳健的计量经济学技术。动态处理效应估计显示，政策实施后调整逐步进行，十年后二氧化碳排放量下降了19%至23%。这些效应主要源于资源替代，而非能源效率的提升，并且并非由对碳价格的短期反应所驱动。我们的结果在控制可再生能源政策潜在影响后依然稳健。这些发现凸显了碳定价政策在引导中期预期及补充气候政策组合中的作用。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The Effectiveness of Carbon Pricing: A Global Evaluation
title_zh: 碳定价的有效性：全球评估

abstract: As economic globalization and the specialization of labour deepen, competition among firms has increasingly shifted towards supply-chain-based competition. Accordingly, the continued enhancement of supply chain resilience has become a key issue in corporate strategic management. Using data on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2008 to 2024, this study examines the effect of shareholder chain relationship networks on corporate supply chain resilience and further explores the underlying mechanisms. The results indicate a significant positive association between shareholder chain relationship networks and corporate supply chain resilience, and the findings remain robust across a series of robustness checks. Mechanism tests demonstrate that operating risk diversification and resource allocation efficiency are important channels through which shareholder chain relationship networks enhance corporate supply chain resilience. Heterogeneity tests show that shareholder chain relationship networks have a more pronounced effect on enhancing supply chain resilience among firms with greater managerial myopia and higher internal control quality. KEYWORDS: Shareholder chain relationship network corporate supply chain resilience operating risk resource allocation JEL CLASSIFICATION: D22 G32 G41
abstract_zh: 随着经济全球化与劳动分工的深化，企业间的竞争日益转向供应链层面的竞争，持续增强供应链韧性由此成为企业战略管理的关键议题。本文利用2008—2024年中国A股上市公司数据，考察了股东链关系网络对企业供应链韧性的影响，并进一步探讨了其作用机制。研究结果表明，股东链关系网络与企业供应链韧性之间存在显著的正向关联，且该结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制检验显示，经营风险分散与资源配置效率是股东链关系网络提升企业供应链韧性的重要渠道。异质性检验表明，在管理者短视程度较高及内部控制质量较高的企业中，股东链关系网络对供应链韧性的提升作用更为显著。关键词：股东链关系网络；企业供应链韧性；经营风险；资源配置 JEL分类：D22 G32 G41

abstract: This study explores whether alternative data provide incremental predictive information for crude oil return forecasting in emerging markets, focusing on China’s Shanghai International Energy Exchange (INE) crude oil futures market. We construct a comprehensive forecasting framework that integrates traditional econometric benchmarks, mixed-frequency specifications, and deep learning models, and evaluate predictive performance through return forecasting, interval prediction for uncertainty quantification, a mean-variance framework for economic value assessment, and interpretable machine learning for information contribution analysis. The results show that deep learning models generally achieve better out-of-sample forecast accuracy and directional predictability than conventional linear benchmarks. Incorporating alternative data provides incremental predictive information beyond traditional predictors and improves the economic performance of forecasting-based portfolios. Furthermore, feature ablation and interpretability analyses reveal that different categories of alternative data provide heterogeneous incremental predictive signals, with their relative importance varying across market conditions. These findings enhance the understanding of how alternative information contributes to return predictability and information processing in the INE market, and offer practical implications for forecasting, risk assessment, and information infrastructure development in this market. KEYWORDS: Alternative data crude oil futures return forecasting emerging markets machine learning JEL CLASSIFICATION: C45 C53 G17 Q41
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了替代数据是否为新兴市场原油期货收益预测提供了增量预测信息，重点关注中国上海国际能源交易中心（INE）原油期货市场。我们构建了一个综合预测框架，整合了传统计量经济学基准模型、混频规格和深度学习模型，并通过收益预测、用于不确定性量化的区间预测、用于经济价值评估的均值-方差框架以及用于信息贡献分析的可解释机器学习来评估预测性能。结果表明，深度学习模型通常比传统线性基准模型实现更好的样本外预测准确性和方向可预测性。纳入替代数据提供了超越传统预测因子的增量预测信息，并改善了基于预测的投资组合的经济表现。此外，特征消融和可解释性分析揭示，不同类别的替代数据提供了异质性的增量预测信号，其相对重要性随市场条件而变化。这些发现增进了对替代信息如何促进INE市场收益可预测性和信息处理的理解，并为该市场的预测、风险评估和信息基础设施建设提供了实践启示。关键词：替代数据 原油期货 收益预测 新兴市场 机器学习 JEL分类号：C45 C53 G17 Q41

abstract: This paper studies how population aging shapes regional adjustment to local shocks. I develop a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model that incorporates aggregate demographic change, life‐cycle variation in migration and employment choices, and forward‐looking investment in local capital. Applying the model to Japan, I find that aging can mitigate welfare losses from a negative local shock. Although older populations are less mobile, reduced outmigration sustains local capital demand and slows capital disinvestment, limiting declines in labor productivity. An extension illustrates the model's use for post‐disaster policy evaluation, highlighting a potential tradeoff between spatial equity and aggregate welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了人口老龄化如何影响区域对局部冲击的调整。我构建了一个动态空间一般均衡模型，该模型整合了总体人口结构变化、迁移与就业选择的生命周期差异，以及前瞻性的地方资本投资。将该模型应用于日本，我发现老龄化能够缓解负面局部冲击带来的福利损失。尽管老年人口流动性较低，但减少的向外迁移维持了地方资本需求，并减缓了资本撤资，从而限制了劳动生产率的下降。一项扩展研究展示了该模型在灾后政策评估中的应用，强调了空间公平与总体福利之间可能存在的权衡。
title: Local Shocks and Regional Dynamics in an Aging Economy
title_zh: 老龄化经济中的局部冲击与区域动态

abstract: We develop a growth model that endogenizes the occupational choice of workers with different ability levels to study how digitalization affects labor income inequality. The framework incorporates digitalization's multifaceted effects on the economy: (i) it influences economic growth through automation, and (ii) it affects labor income inequality through labor productivity (demand side) and labor time modulation (supply side). We examine how these channels influence wage inequality between skilled and unskilled workers, within each skill group, and economy‐wide. The analysis reveals that digitalization's impact on labor income inequality—whether exacerbating or mitigating disparities—depends on the inequality metric employed.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个增长模型，将不同能力水平工人的职业选择内生化，以研究数字化如何影响劳动收入不平等。该框架整合了数字化对经济的多方面效应：（i）通过自动化影响经济增长，（ii）通过劳动生产率（需求侧）和劳动时间调节（供给侧）影响劳动收入不平等。我们考察了这些渠道如何影响技能与非技能工人之间、各技能群体内部以及整个经济范围内的工资不平等。分析表明，数字化对劳动收入不平等的影响——无论是加剧还是缓解差距——取决于所采用的不平等度量指标。
title: Does Digitalization Widen Labor Income Inequality?
title_zh: 数字化会扩大劳动收入不平等吗？

abstract: Forest carbon gross emissions from deforestation and degradation arise from interconnected socio-economic and ecological processes, including demographic pressure, urban expansion, and land-use transformation. In Ethiopia, these drivers exhibit strong spatial interdependence and temporal persistence, generating heterogeneous emission patterns that conventional econometric approaches may not sufficiently capture, especially the dynamic spatial characteristics of forest carbon emissions. This study examines the drivers of forest carbon gross emissions (FCGE) across time, space, and emission intensities using an integrated spatiotemporal framework that combines dynamic panel GMM estimation with spatial econometric models and the dynamic spatial Durbin model (DSDM)—alongside quantile regression analysis. Dynamic panel results show that population growth significantly increases FCGE, while the significant lagged FCGE term indicates strong persistence in forest carbon emissions over time. DSDM estimates indicate significant temporal persistence and spatial spillover effects, confirming that FCGE are driven by processes that are simultaneously dynamic and spatial, with stronger influences arising from boundary adjacency than from road network connectivity and distance decay. A 10% relative increase in urbanization is associated with an approximate 32% rise in emissions. Quantile regression results indicate strong asymmetries, with demographic, market, and land-use pressures exerting larger effects in high-emission regions. Overall, the findings underscore the need for coordinated, region-specific policies to mitigate FCGE, including early interventions to prevent persistent forest disturbances, targeted protection of vulnerable forest frontiers, stronger regulation of urban expansion, and locally tailored forest restoration strategies. The study provides robust, systems-based evidence to enhance REDD + implementation and climate-resilient environmental governance in Ethiopia and beyond.
abstract_zh: 毁林和森林退化导致的森林碳总排放量，源于社会经济与生态过程的相互交织，包括人口压力、城市扩张和土地利用转型。在埃塞俄比亚，这些驱动因素表现出强烈的空间相互依赖性和时间持续性，产生了异质性的排放模式，而传统计量经济学方法可能无法充分捕捉这些特征，尤其是森林碳排放的动态空间特性。本研究采用一个整合的时空框架，结合动态面板GMM估计、空间计量模型、动态空间杜宾模型（DSDM）以及分位数回归分析，考察森林碳总排放量（FCGE）在时间、空间和排放强度上的驱动因素。动态面板结果显示，人口增长显著增加FCGE，而显著的滞后FCGE项表明森林碳排放随时间具有强烈的持续性。DSDM估计显示显著的时间持续性和空间溢出效应，证实FCGE由同时具有动态性和空间性的过程驱动，且边界邻近性比道路网络连通性和距离衰减产生更强的影响。城市化相对增长10%与排放量约32%的上升相关。分位数回归结果显示显著的不对称性，人口、市场和土地利用压力在高排放地区产生更大的影响。总体而言，研究结果强调了需要协调一致、针对特定区域的政策来减缓FCGE，包括早期干预以防止持续的森林干扰、对脆弱森林前沿进行有针对性的保护、加强对城市扩张的监管，以及因地制宜的森林恢复策略。本研究提供了基于系统的稳健证据，以增强埃塞俄比亚及其他地区的REDD+实施和气候适应性环境治理。

abstract: This paper investigates how Chinese film exports shape international perceptions of China and associated economic outcomes, drawing on high‐frequency media data from the Global Database of Events, Language and Tone. We match the overseas release dates of 906 Chinese films across more than 120 countries to 355,867 media reports spanning April 2013 to October 2025, treating release timing as a quasi‐natural experiment. A difference‐in‐differences design identifies the causal effect of film exposure on country image, proxied by the sentiment of local media coverage. Baseline estimates indicate that releases produce a statistically significant improvement in the average tone of China‐related reporting, a result that withstands an extensive battery of sensitivity checks. The effect is modest in magnitude, consistent with the limited overseas box‐office reach of most Chinese films, and concentrated in the short run, operating chiefly by altering the surrounding media information environment rather than through mass theatrical viewership. Heterogeneity analyses reveal stronger responses in culturally proximate settings, middle‐ and high‐income economies, Belt and Road Initiative partners, and contexts where prior sentiment toward China is comparatively favourable, with international co‐productions and higher‐rated films yielding larger gains. Mechanism evidence shows that exposure heightens public attention and information‐seeking, thereby fostering more positive evaluations. These improvements carry economically meaningful consequences, including increased imports from China and enhanced appeal as a destination for international students. Because gains accrue primarily among already favourable audiences, the findings suggest a reinforcement rather than persuasion mechanism, illustrating both the potential and the constraints of film as a soft‐power instrument.
abstract_zh: 本文利用全球事件、语言与语调数据库中的高频媒体数据，考察中国电影出口如何塑造国际社会对中国的认知及其相关经济后果。我们将906部中国电影在120多个国家的海外上映日期与2013年4月至2025年10月间的355,867篇媒体报道进行匹配，并将上映时点视为准自然实验。通过双重差分设计，我们识别出电影曝光对国家形象（以当地媒体报道情感倾向为代理变量）的因果效应。基准估计表明，电影上映显著改善了涉华报道的平均语调，且该结果在大量敏感性检验中保持稳健。效应幅度较为温和，与多数中国电影有限的海外票房影响力相符，且集中于短期，主要通过改变周边媒体信息环境而非大规模影院观影发挥作用。异质性分析显示，在文化相近情境、中高收入经济体、“一带一路”倡议伙伴国以及先前对华情感相对友好的环境中，响应更为显著；国际合拍片和评分较高的电影带来更大增益。机制证据表明，电影曝光提升了公众关注度和信息搜寻行为，从而促进更积极的评价。这些改善具有经济层面的实质意义，包括增加从中国的进口以及提升作为国际学生目的地的吸引力。由于增益主要集中于本就持友好态度的受众群体，研究结果提示一种强化而非说服机制，既展示了电影作为软实力工具的潜力，也揭示了其局限性。

abstract: 农业生产的季节性深刻影响着劳动力配置与经济结构转型，但这一关键因素在既有研究和政策框架中尚未得到充分重视。本文构建两部门、两时期理论模型，分析农闲劳动力流动对非农扩张的影响，并基于清代《刑科题本》构建18—19世纪中国府级面板数据进行实证检验。研究发现：农业季节性总体上促进区域经济发展，机制在于农闲期释放的劳动力以佣工形式进入手工业和服务业，推动劳动力跨部门配置。进一步分析表明，较高的政府治理能力、较强的宗族组织以及良好的地方文教环境，有助于降低劳动力匹配与市场交易成本，促进季节性劳动力转化为生产性就业。空间异质性显示，在非农能力不足的地区，农业季节性可能导致失业增加，而在长江流域及南方地区，农闲劳动力更容易转化为非农就业。时间异质性表明，随着经济结构演进，农业季节性边际作用减弱。本文从农业时间结构视角补充了二元经济与内卷化讨论，也为理解乡村振兴中统筹农闲就业承接、农忙用工保障与县域产业发展关系提供了历史经验。

abstract: While bushmeat can be a crucial protein source for food insecure households, its consumption and trade raise significant concerns for both human health and wildlife conservation. Here we investigate how rainfall shocks influence rural households’ income from and reliance on bushmeat hunting. Drawing on data from nearly 8,000 rural households across 24 low- and middle-income countries, matched to gridded rainfall records and detailed agricultural season calendars, our study distinguishes between the effects of shocks depending on their type, intensity and timing of occurrence within the agricultural cycle. We mitigate endogeneity concerns faced in prior studies relying on self-reported shocks and cross-sectional data, by constructing a quarterly household panel survey integrated with objective, high-resolution data on climatic moisture stress. We find that dry conditions increase both bushmeat income and its share in total household income, particularly during critical agricultural periods. Conversely, wet conditions have the opposite effect, often decreasing hunting due to improved agricultural yields. However, these effects vary depending on the intensity of wet conditions. Additionally, we find heterogeneity in responses across socio-economic strata, as wealthier households tend to have higher bushmeat income during dry periods, likely due to better access to resources. The study increases our understanding of when and by whom climate stressors induce greater wildlife offtake, providing important insight for targeted development and conservation policy.
abstract_zh: 尽管丛林肉对于粮食不安全的家庭而言可能是关键的蛋白质来源，但其消费和贸易对人类健康与野生动物保护均构成重大关切。本研究探讨了降雨冲击如何影响农村家庭从丛林肉狩猎中获得的收入及其依赖程度。基于覆盖24个中低收入国家近8000户农村家庭的数据，结合网格化降雨记录和详细的农业季节日历，我们的研究区分了冲击类型、强度及其在农业周期内发生时间的不同影响。通过构建季度家庭面板调查，并整合关于气候水分胁迫的客观高分辨率数据，我们缓解了先前依赖自我报告冲击和横截面数据的研究所面临的内生性问题。研究发现，干旱条件增加了丛林肉收入及其在家庭总收入中的占比，尤其是在关键农业时期。相反，湿润条件则产生相反效果，通常因农业产量提高而减少狩猎活动。然而，这些效应随湿润条件强度的不同而变化。此外，我们观察到不同社会经济阶层间的反应存在异质性，较富裕家庭在干旱时期往往拥有更高的丛林肉收入，这可能归因于其更好的资源获取能力。本研究增进了我们对气候压力何时以及由谁引发更大野生动物捕获量的理解，为有针对性的发展和保护政策提供了重要见解。
title: Weathering hard times with bushmeat: rural household coping under rainfall shocks
title_zh: 以丛林肉应对艰难时期：降雨冲击下农村家庭的应对策略

abstract: 区域发展不平衡是发展中大国普遍面临的问题。如何在不断缩小与发达国家之间差距的同时，有效破解国内区域发展不平衡问题，实现高水平区域协调发展，是摆在我们面前的一大世界性难题，也是中国共产党人必须回答的时代之问。针对这一时代之问，习近平总书记从中国国情和实际出发，发表了一系列关于区域协调发展的重要论述，深刻揭示了区域经济演变规律，科学回答了中国区域协调发展中的重大理论和现实问题，创新提出了在发展中促进相对平衡、区域协调发展一盘棋等新思想、新观点、新论断，并推动实施了区域重大战略和区域协调发展战略，形成一个完整的理论体系，丰富和发展了世界区域经济理论，为全方位推动区域协调发展、走中国特色区域协调发展道路提供了根本遵循。本文在阐述新时代区域协调发展科学内涵的基础上，深入考察了中国特色区域协调发展道路的理论意涵，并从完善战略体系、机制体系和政策体系三维视角提出了中国特色区域协调发展道路的实践路径。

abstract: 传统生产力及其发展范式无法全面实现人与自然和谐共生，全面推进中国式现代化需要全新的能源体制和工业模式。新质生产力的提出，从结构视角破解了这一难题，在统筹全面绿色转型与经济增长的同时，提供了从工业文明向生态文明转型的理论证成和实践指引，其根本宗旨在于引导建立“人、自然、生产力”三者之间的良性循环系统和持续正向反馈机制，孕育形成生态文明的内核。基于新质生产力的支撑，一个将自然资本收益内生化，以人的福祉为目标的发展范式将重塑人类文明。更进一步，论文阐释了新质生产力推动全面绿色转型，构建生态文明的理论逻辑与方法论基础，在此基础上提出“宏观体制机制改革—中观产业结构跃升—微观技术创新”的实践进路。毫无疑问，新质生产力理论是马克思主义生产力理论的巨大创新，是中国经济学自主知识体系的重要组成部分。

abstract: 产业政策对实现国家技术主权与保障经济安全至关重要。本文基于企业微观行为视角，在分析企业创新“行为约束”的基础上，构建了一个内生化行为偏差的异质性创新模型，揭示阻碍企业技术跃迁的深层微观机制，探究中国产业政策如何助力企业技术突破。研究发现，企业技术突破存在一个由“渐进改良转向突破式创新”和“突破式创新回归保守策略”两个临界点所构成的创新窗口期，而中国产业政策正是通过托底型助推和激励型助推拓展了这一窗口期，从而助力企业进行持续性技术突破探索。以“制造强国战略”为准自然实验的实证研究亦证实了这一机制。本文结论不仅为揭示中国产业政策成功之谜提供了一个企业微观行为分析框架，更为产业政策有效缓解企业行为约束，进而通过“行为助推”系统地引导和释放企业创新潜能提供政策启示。

abstract: 当前，“内卷式”竞争正成为抑制企业创新活力、阻滞产业高质量跃迁的关键问题。本文聚焦中国制造业产业链层面“内卷式”竞争的形成机制与治理路径，通过构建链主企业、供应商与消费者的三方动态博弈模型，揭示纵向博弈与横向竞争双重作用下“内卷式”竞争产生的微观机理。研究发现，链主企业虽然对于产业链稳定和技术创新有一定积极作用，但若放任其在产业链中的主导性持续强化，可能引发三种负面效应：（1）产业链低端锁定效应，形成长期“低质量、低价格、低利润”的均衡陷阱；（2）利益分配失衡，产业链利润分配呈现“马太效应”，中小微企业利润空间收窄；（3）政策传导低效，产业补贴存在“截留效应”，大部分补贴转移至链主企业。基于价值链治理与制度变迁理论，本文提出“行业协会协同治理+渐进式质量标准演进”的双轨治理路径：一方面，通过多中心治理结构降低单边依赖度；另一方面，通过设定动态质量标准引导产品质量升级。本研究将产业链治理从“有效市场+有为政府”的二元范式拓展至包含行业自组织与质量标准引领的多元框架，为综合整治“内卷式”竞争提供了理论支撑与可操作路径。

abstract: 技术标准国际对接是我国主动融入全球创新网络，实现以开放促创新的高水平制度型开放举措。本文通过自然语言处理方法测度专利文本与采标技术标准文本相似度，识别企业受技术标准国际对接的影响程度，结合高维固定效应模型实证检验技术标准国际对接对企业国际创新合作的影响。研究发现，技术标准国际对接通过降低跨国技术协调成本、契约风险成本以及贸易摩擦引致的不确定性冲击，显著提升企业国际创新合作水平。但技术标准国际对接并未有效反哺国内创新，原因在于当前我国融入全球创新网络过程中技术标准对接模式的不匹配。以国际合作专利成果署名顺序为切入点的研究发现，完全等同、等效采用国际标准虽能更有效提高我国企业国际合作创新水平，但对其创新主导能力的提升有限；而采用与中国技术发展阶段更匹配的修改后采标方式进行标准对接，能有效提升国内企业国际创新合作主导能力，提高企业创新质量、突破企业自身创新边界、扩大企业创新国际影响力。基于企业创新相对基础差异的深入分析发现，创新基础较弱的企业盲目追求标准一致性是导致技术标准国际对接难以反哺国内创新的关键。本研究从标准制度型开放视角，为我国充分利用全球创新资源、实现科技创新自立自强提供了现实方案和经验证据。

abstract: 2017—2019年，为反制美国对华加征的关税，中国对来自美国的进口产品实施了反制性关税措施，同时主动降低了对其他贸易伙伴的进口关税。本文基于包含最终品与中间投入品的非位似嵌套常替代弹性需求系统，结合丰富的家庭消费支出数据、贸易数据与关税数据，量化评估了这一非对称关税调整对中国城镇家庭消费者福利的总体影响及其分配效应。研究发现：（1）对美反制关税对单个家庭带来的消费者福利损失总体温和可控，约占家庭支出的0.11%。（2）对其他国家降低关税使家庭消费者福利平均上升0.08%，很大程度上抵消了反制关税带来的负面冲击。（3）非对称关税调整促使进口来源地从美国转向其他国家，降低了家庭对美国进口的依赖程度，从而进一步削弱了反制关税对消费者福利的不利影响。（4）从分配效应来看，由于低收入家庭消费了更多可贸易品，尤其是受反制关税影响较大的食品与农产品，因此加征关税对低收入群体的影响略大；而对其他国家调降关税则未带来明显的福利分配效应。本文从家庭消费者福利的视角，为近年来我国贸易政策调整的经济效应提供了定量评估，并表明扩大自主开放、促进进口来源地多元化，有助于缓解中美贸易摩擦对我国经济的冲击。

abstract: 近年来，持续演化的贸易冲击对中国劳动力市场产生了复杂而深远的影响。关税频繁变动对劳动力市场的影响不仅关系到就业总量稳定，也关系到岗位结构与技能配置的再平衡，是高质量就业发展进程中不可忽视的外部变量。本文基于国内主流招聘平台岗位微观数据，创新性地融合大语言模型与自然语言处理技术，系统识别了美国加征关税对中国城市劳动力需求规模、岗位结构和技能配置的多重影响，并厘清其影响路径和异质性。研究发现，外部加征关税显著抑制了城市线上招聘总量，这一影响主要作用于扩展边际，即招聘企业数量缩减，而非集约边际下企业平均招聘强度下滑。进一步结合工商注册企业数据与企业微观财务数据的分析表明：扩展边际的收缩特征主要体现为企业暂时停止招聘，而非退出市场；贸易冲击推升企业成本并压缩盈利，从而导致企业暂停招聘。异质性分析显示，冲击对低学历、低经验及常规体力技能相关岗位的抑制更强；贸易多元化程度更高、政策环境更稳定的城市表现出更强的就业韧性。本文的研究从数量、结构和技能视角厘清了贸易冲击对中国劳动力市场带来的多重影响，为稳主体、促多元化与促进劳动力转型的政策制定提供实证支撑，也为推动实现高质量充分就业提供经验启示。

abstract: 财政紧平衡背景下，如何提高财政支出效率、提升财政支撑现代化建设的能力成为备受关注的话题。数字技术应用正在引领国家治理方式变革，但其能否在提升财政支出效率中发挥积极作用，仍有待深入探讨。本文依托预算管理一体化这一财政管理数字化的核心工程，利用2016—2022年的地级市面板数据，实证分析了数字技术应用对财政支出效率的影响。研究发现，一体化系统上线显著提高了地方财政支出效率；其中，提高预算过程管理效能、优化预算资源配置是预算管理一体化促进支出效率提高的重要机制。异质性分析显示，预算管理一体化的作用在政府规模较大、财政自主权较高、前期财政支出效率较低的城市中更强。最后，本文未能发现预算管理一体化对缓解财政压力有显著作用，这意味着本文发现的效率提升，更多来自产出端的改进，并没有破除支出扩张冲动与促进增收。本文为评估数字技术促进国家治理的成效提供了来自财政领域的证据，对进一步健全现代预算制度有所启示。

abstract: 数字生产力作为新质生产力的核心驱动因素，科学评估其福利效应对实现民生改善与共同富裕目标具有重要意义。本文基于量化空间一般均衡模型，估计了2003—2019年232个城市数字生产率增长的福利效应。研究结果表明，数字生产率的提升为我国居民平均带来34.29%的福利增长。其中，数字部门生产率增长贡献28.59%，数字资本相对劳动生产率增长贡献8.96%。对福利效应进行渠道分解发现，物价下降贡献了68.4%的福利增长，而收入增长机制贡献相对有限。与此同时，福利效应呈现增长与分化并存的特征。在需求结构差异与劳动技能溢价影响下，福利分配倾向于高收入、高技能群体，短期内引致群体间福利分化。从长期来看，随着数字资本深化、数字消费便利普惠共享与数字成果公平分配，居民福利将逐步迈向均衡增长路径。

abstract: 在全方位扩大内需的政策背景下，家电国补政策成为政府短期提振消费的重要手段，同时也深刻影响着市场价格传导与行业竞争格局。本文基于Salop竞争框架构建多企业定价博弈模型，刻画消费补贴如何通过降低家电商品实际支付价格、扩大补贴期市场规模并强化企业间竞争，影响价格传导与财政乘数效应。基于手工整理的16000余条家电国补覆盖商品，结合家电商品价格、品牌销量和企业财务数据，本文综合评估了家电国补政策的价格传导与财政乘数效应。研究发现，家电国补政策后消费者购买参与商品的价格平均下降约22%，超出名义补贴上限（20%），且消费者获得了全部补贴红利，存在价格下行现象。价格下行并非补贴的直接结果，而是通过加剧家电企业间价格竞争造成的。集中度较低行业、价格未触顶商品及新上市商品的价格反应更强。同时，家电国补政策显著提升了品牌销量和企业盈利，也加速了市场向头部品牌集中。在量价联动的基础上，本文进一步分析了家电国补政策的财政乘数效应，发现每1元财政补贴可带来1.2元—2.3元的消费增量。本文为进一步优化消费补贴政策设计，更好发挥扩大内需战略支点作用提供重要政策启示。

abstract: During the 2015 refugee crisis, nearly one million refugees arrived in Germany, raising widespread concern that crimes against natives would rise. Using novel county-level data, we study this question empirically in first-difference and two-stage least squares (2SLS) regressions. Our results do not support the view that Germans were victimized in greater numbers by refugees, as measured by their rate of victimization in crimes with refugee suspects. Our findings are of great policy and public interest, and also of material relevance for the broader literature on immigration and crime, which mostly considers crimes per capita or variants thereof. We show that such aggregate measures may be insufficiently informative about the actual victimization patterns of specific groups.
abstract_zh: 在2015年难民危机期间，近百万难民抵达德国，引发了关于本土居民犯罪率可能上升的广泛担忧。利用新颖的县级数据，我们通过一阶差分和两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）回归对此问题进行了实证研究。我们的结果并不支持德国人遭受难民犯罪侵害数量增加的观点，这一结论基于难民嫌疑人犯罪中的受害率来衡量。我们的发现具有重要的政策与公众意义，同时也对更广泛的移民与犯罪研究文献具有实质性参考价值，该领域文献大多关注人均犯罪率或其变体。我们指出，这类总体指标可能不足以充分反映特定群体的实际受害模式。
title: Immigration and crimes against natives: the 2015 refugee crisis in Germany
title_zh: 移民与针对本地人的犯罪：2015年德国难民危机

abstract: What gave rise to the mosaic of cultural expressions across the globe? Why are some societies more culturally diverse than others? This study develops a unified theory of cultural evolution, characterizing the forces that have governed this process over the course of human existence. The research advances the hypothesis that population movements and socioeconomic transformations generated a mismatch between inherited cultural traits and prevailing ecological and societal conditions, setting in motion an evolutionary process governed by adaptation-based vertical transmission, horizontal diffusion, and fitness-based evolutionary selection. The theory generates novel testable predictions concerning the origins of the global cultural mosaic and the cross-societal variation in cultural diversity. First, greater ecological distance between ancestral environments generated greater cultural distance across societies. Second, prehistoric differences in ancestral diversity contributed to divergent adaptive capacity and greater cultural distance. Third, societies descended from more diverse prehistoric populations exhibit greater cultural diversity despite convergence induced by adaptation to a common environment and societal norms. Drawing on measures of cultural distance and diversity derived from folkloric and musical traditions among ethnic groups, visual representations of common concepts, and the dispersion of norms, values, and attitudes, the empirical analysis lends credence to the predictions of the theory.
abstract_zh: 是什么造就了全球文化表现形式的马赛克式多样性？为何某些社会的文化多样性程度高于其他社会？本研究构建了一个统一的文化演化理论，刻画了在人类历史进程中主导这一过程的种种力量。研究提出假设，认为人口迁移与社会经济转型导致了遗传下来的文化特质与当时生态及社会条件之间的错配，从而启动了一个由基于适应的垂直传递、水平扩散及基于适应性的进化选择所支配的演化过程。该理论就全球文化马赛克的起源及跨社会文化多样性差异提出了新颖的可检验预测。首先，祖先环境间更大的生态距离导致了跨社会间更大的文化距离。其次，史前祖先多样性的差异促成了不同的适应能力及更大的文化距离。第三，尽管因适应共同环境和社会规范而出现趋同，源自更大多样性史前人口的社会仍展现出更大的文化多样性。基于从族群间的民俗与音乐传统、共同概念的视觉表征以及规范、价值观和态度的分布中提取的文化距离与多样性度量，实证分析为理论的预测提供了支持。
title: Cultural Evolution
title_zh: 文化演化

abstract: Firms shape public policy not only from the outside through lobbying and campaign contributions, but also from the inside when business owners hold public office. We study this channel using a novel dataset that links state legislators’ personal financial disclosures to bill sponsorship records across 26 U.S. states from 2009 to 2023. The disclosures allow us to observe business ownership during legislative service and to distinguish entrepreneurs, defined as legislators who both own and actively manage a firm, from passive shareholders and employees. Applying a large language model to bill text, we classify legislation as pro-business and identify a subset of pro-entry bills that reduce barriers facing new firms. Entrepreneurs are a substantial presence in state legislatures, accounting for over 40 percent of legislators, and their representation varies primarily across states rather than within states over time. Although entrepreneurs do not sponsor more bills overall, they initiate a greater share of bills as first or sole primary sponsor. They also do not appear to be generic advocates for business. Relative to legislators with other business ties, entrepreneurs are no more likely to sponsor pro-business bills or bills endorsed by state Chambers of Commerce. Instead, they selectively advance pro-entry legislation, especially bills related to deregulation and innovation rather than antitrust or access to capital. These findings document an important channel through which entrepreneurs shape the policy environment for entrepreneurship from within political institutions.
abstract_zh: 企业不仅通过游说和竞选捐款等外部途径影响公共政策，还通过企业主担任公职这一内部渠道发挥作用。我们利用一项新颖的数据集来研究这一渠道，该数据集将美国26个州2009年至2023年间州议员的个人财务披露与法案提案记录相链接。财务披露使我们能够观察到议员在任职期间的企业所有权情况，并将企业家——即既拥有又积极管理企业的议员——与被动股东和雇员区分开来。我们运用大型语言模型对法案文本进行分类，将立法划分为亲商类型，并识别出一类减少新企业面临障碍的亲准入法案。企业家在州议会中占据重要地位，占议员总数的40%以上，其代表性差异主要体现为州际差异，而非州内随时间的变化。尽管企业家总体上并未提出更多法案，但他们作为第一或唯一主要提案人发起法案的比例更高。此外，他们并非笼统的商业利益代言人。相较于具有其他商业关联的议员，企业家提出亲商法案或获得州商会支持法案的可能性并未更高。相反，他们有针对性地推进亲准入立法，尤其是与放松管制和创新相关的法案，而非反垄断或资本获取方面的法案。这些发现揭示了企业家从政治机构内部塑造创业政策环境的重要渠道。
title: Political Entrepreneurs
title_zh: 政治企业家

abstract: In instrumental-variable (IV) studies, researchers often evaluate multiple candidate instruments and selectively report the specification with the most favorable first- or second-stage statistics. We show that this form of instrument selection (“instrument-hacking”) induces median bias in IV estimators toward the OLS estimand, undermining the rationale for using IV. When all candidate instruments have the same true strength, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. More generally, when candidate instruments differ in true strength, monotonicity need not hold because increasing the number of instruments can lead researchers to select genuinely stronger instruments. Nonetheless, in simulations calibrated to the empirical distribution of instrument strengths in the IV literature, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. Furthermore, it is substantial in magnitude, even when only a few instruments are available.
abstract_zh: 在工具变量（IV）研究中，研究者常评估多个候选工具变量，并选择性地报告一阶段或二阶段统计量最有利的规格。我们证明，这种工具选择形式（“工具操纵”）会导致IV估计量向OLS估计量产生中位数偏误，削弱了使用IV的合理性。当所有候选工具变量具有相同的真实强度时，中位数偏误随可用工具数量的增加而单调递增。更一般地，当候选工具变量在真实强度上存在差异时，单调性不一定成立，因为增加工具数量可能促使研究者选择真正更强的工具。然而，在基于IV文献中工具强度经验分布校准的模拟中，中位数偏误随可用工具数量的增加而单调递增。此外，即使仅有少量工具可用，其偏误幅度也相当可观。
title: Instrument Hacking
title_zh: 工具变量操纵

abstract: As of July 2026, 23 states had approved policies that disallow spending of SNAP benefits on sugary drinks. The effects of such restrictions on consumption are unclear, however, since most households can simply switch to buying sugary drinks with non-SNAP funds. Using a difference-in- differences design with nationwide grocery purchase panel data, we estimate that restrictions in the first 10 states reduced the average SNAP household’s retail purchases of excluded drinks by 12.4 percent (standard error = 1.0) over the first half of 2026. In states that excluded only some sugary drinks, SNAP households partially substituted to non-excluded drinks. Surveys we carried out before and after implementation show that the restrictions increased SNAP recipients’ perceptions of stigma. We combine our estimated consumption reductions with external parameters to model welfare effects given an over-consumption internality and a fiscal externality via public health care spending. In our model, excluding all sugary drinks from SNAP nationwide would provide benefits of about $1.1 billion per year, of which about 70 percent is from reduced health care costs.
abstract_zh: 截至2026年7月，已有23个州批准了禁止使用SNAP福利购买含糖饮料的政策。然而，此类限制对消费的影响尚不明确，因为大多数家庭可以简单地改用非SNAP资金购买含糖饮料。利用全国杂货购买面板数据，采用双重差分设计，我们估计前10个州的限制措施使平均SNAP家庭在2026年上半年对排除饮品的零售购买量减少了12.4%（标准误=1.0）。在仅排除部分含糖饮料的州，SNAP家庭部分转向了未被排除的饮品。我们在实施前后进行的调查显示，这些限制增加了SNAP受助者对污名化的感知。我们将估算的消费减少量与外部参数相结合，在过度消费内部性和通过公共卫生保健支出的财政外部性框架下，对福利效应进行建模。在我们的模型中，全国范围内将SNAP中所有含糖饮料排除在外，每年可带来约11亿美元的收益，其中约70%来自医疗保健成本的降低。
title: The Effects of SNAP Sugary Drink Restrictions on Consumption and Welfare
title_zh: SNAP含糖饮料限制对消费与福利的影响

abstract: Ordinal mechanisms use rankings but not preference intensities. Cardinal mechanisms also elicit school utilities, allowing them to use students’ preferences over assignment lotteries. We compare probabilistic serial with four cardinal mechanisms that maximize the same welfare objective under successively stronger restrictions: capacity-only, ε-envy-free, envy-free, and a welfare-maximizing cardinal-preference pseudomarket. Because the feasible sets are nested, maximum welfare weakly falls as the restrictions tighten from capacity alone to approximate no-envy, exact no-envy, and equal budgets with common prices. We establish positive and negative results on large-market truthtelling. All 44 theorem parts in the paper are machine-checked in the Lean 4 proof assistant. We develop methods for computing cardinal-preference pseudomarket equilibria for Seattle’s 898 students and 11 schools. Using set-identified cardinal preferences from Seattle high-school choice data, we estimate that, under exact capacity, capacity-only raises mean welfare over probabilistic serial by 0.053, equivalent to shifting 5.3 percentage points of assignment probability from the average student’s worst school to the top school. Exact envy-freeness retains 79% of this gain; best-found pseudomarket equilibria yield a mean gain of 0.002. The estimates show both the value of cardinal information and the welfare cost of pseudomarket fairness restrictions.
abstract_zh: 序数机制使用排名但不使用偏好强度。基数机制还引出学校效用，从而能够利用学生对分配抽签的偏好。我们将概率序列与四种基数机制进行比较，这些机制在依次增强的限制条件下最大化相同的福利目标：仅容量限制、ε-无嫉妒、无嫉妒，以及福利最大化的基数偏好伪市场。由于可行集是嵌套的，随着限制从仅容量到近似无嫉妒、精确无嫉妒以及具有共同价格的均等预算逐步收紧，最大福利呈弱下降趋势。我们在大市场诚实报告方面建立了正反两方面的结果。论文中所有44个定理部分均在Lean 4证明助手中进行了机器验证。我们开发了计算西雅图898名学生和11所学校基数偏好伪市场均衡的方法。利用西雅图高中选择数据中集合识别的基数偏好，我们估计，在精确容量下，仅容量限制相对于概率序列将平均福利提高了0.053，相当于将平均学生从最差学校到顶尖学校的分配概率转移了5.3个百分点。精确无嫉妒保留了这一增益的79%；最佳发现的伪市场均衡产生的平均增益为0.002。这些估计既显示了基数信息的价值，也揭示了伪市场公平限制的福利成本。
title: Measuring the Welfare Gains from Cardinal-Preference Mechanisms in School Choice
title_zh: 衡量学校选择中基数偏好机制的福利收益

abstract: In recent decades, economists studying international trade have gained access to an unprecedented volume and variety of data. These data have provided new insights and a more granular understanding of the mechanics of trade. Analyzing a large corpus of papers, we document that the nature of research has also shifted. Previously, the typical trade paper was either purely theoretical or an empirical paper testing theoretical predictions. More recently, scholarship has shifted toward a more integrated approach, particularly quantitative modeling. This development is surprising. We might have expected the data revolution (and contemporaneous credibility revolution) to increase the share of primarily empirical papers—although the markers of these revolutions are clearly evident in the rise of causal inference within empirical work. This article reviews these developments, assessing the strengths and limitations of different modes of inquiry, and plotting a path forward to harness the growing richness of data within the field.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，研究国际贸易的经济学家得以接触到前所未有的海量且多样化的数据。这些数据为理解贸易机制提供了新的洞见和更为精细的视角。通过分析大量论文，我们发现研究性质也发生了转变。以往，典型的贸易论文要么是纯理论性的，要么是检验理论预测的实证研究。而近年来，学术研究趋向于更加综合的方法，尤其是定量建模。这一发展出乎意料。我们或许会预期数据革命（以及同时期的可信度革命）会增加以实证为主的论文比例——尽管这些革命的标志在实证研究中因果推断的兴起中显而易见。本文回顾了这些发展，评估了不同研究模式的优势与局限，并规划了在该领域内利用日益丰富数据的未来路径。
title: The Data Revolution, and Its Uses, in International Trade
title_zh: 数据革命及其在国际贸易中的应用

abstract: The 2016 Panama Papers leak tightened regulatory enforcement around money laundering and offshore banking. We investigate whether the diversion of foreign aid in developing countries led to a shift to cryptocurrency as an alternative laundering platform. We develop a disbursement-timed forensic measure of cryptocurrency activity, combining on-chain Bitcoin transactions and wallet creation, off-chain exchange records, and IP-linked web traffic, and apply it to World Bank aid disbursements covering $238 billion across the 93 recipient countries in our estimation sample during 2018-2024. Exploiting the administrative timing of aid tranche arrivals, we find sharp, short-lived surges of crypto activity at the disbursement month, driven mainly by anonymous and newly created wallets on both tax-haven and mainstream exchanges. Blockchain forensics reveal patterns consistent with the placement, layering, and integration sequence of conventional money laundering. We estimate an implied leakage of 2 to 6 cents per aid dollar, which amounts to roughly 1.7 to 4.4 billion dollars of aid diversion across the tranche arrivals we study. Capture carries no funding penalty: the four sectors where we detect it, Transport, Water and Sanitation, Social Protection, and Governance, still absorb half of subsequent World Bank funding. Cryptocurrency facilitates aid diversion, but its transparent ledgers also leave forensic traces that may help detect and recover diverted funds.
abstract_zh: 2016年巴拿马文件泄露事件加强了围绕洗钱和离岸银行业务的监管执法。我们研究发展中国家对外援助的转移是否导致了向加密货币作为替代洗钱平台的转变。我们开发了一种基于支付时间点的法证测量方法，结合链上比特币交易和钱包创建、链下交易所记录以及IP关联的网络流量，并将其应用于世界银行2018-2024年间覆盖我们估计样本中93个受援国、总额达2380亿美元的援助支付。利用援助款项分批到账的行政时间安排，我们发现援助支付当月加密货币活动出现急剧且短暂的激增，主要由匿名和新创建的钱包在避税天堂和主流交易所驱动。区块链取证揭示了与传统洗钱中的放置、分层和整合阶段相一致的模式。我们估计每援助美元隐含泄漏2至6美分，在我们研究的款项到账事件中，相当于约17亿至44亿美元的援助转移。被捕获的转移行为不带来资金惩罚：我们检测到转移的四个部门——交通、供水和卫生、社会保护以及治理——仍然吸收了世界银行后续资金的一半。加密货币便利了援助转移，但其透明账本也留下了可能有助于检测和追回被转移资金的取证痕迹。
title: Crypto Capture of Foreign Aid
title_zh: 加密货币对外国援助的俘获

abstract: The green energy transition will be powered by the mining and processing of lithium, nickel, and cobalt, which are critical for the production of advanced batteries. These minerals are concentrated geographically but traded globally, allowing key mining countries to exercise market power through policy intervention. Advanced batteries use multiple minerals in combination, and this joint use creates interdependence across mineral markets. We study the geopolitical implications of these forces and their consequences for green technology adoption worldwide. We quantify supply chain vulnerability, international policy spillovers, and the potential for mineral cartels.
abstract_zh: 绿色能源转型将由锂、镍和钴的开采与加工驱动，这些矿物对先进电池的生产至关重要。这些矿物在地理上集中分布，但全球范围内交易，使得主要采矿国能够通过政策干预行使市场力量。先进电池组合使用多种矿物，这种联合使用在矿物市场间形成了相互依存关系。我们研究这些力量的地缘政治影响及其对全球绿色技术采纳的后果。我们量化供应链脆弱性、国际政策溢出效应以及矿物卡特尔的可能性。
china_relevance_reason: 论文研究全球关键矿产、地缘政治与绿色转型，未明确聚焦中国，研究对象和背景为全球性，故判定为非中国研究。
title: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
title_zh: 关键矿产、地缘政治与绿色转型

abstract: We introduce the notion of marginal cumulative multiplier — the effect of either government spending or taxation on output holding the other fiscal instrument constant — and apply it to a well known panel of consolidation episodes in 16 countries in the period 1978-2020. In our benchmark specification we estimate a marginal spending multiplier at two years of 1.5 and a marginal tax multiplier close to 0. We also estimate similar multipliers by applying the policy counterfactual method of McKay and Wolf (2023). In an extensive robustness analysis we never find spending multipliers below 1.3 or tax multipliers higher than -1. These findings are seemingly in contrast to those of much of the existing literature on fiscal multipliers, which typically finds higher tax than spending multipliers. We show that this contradiction disappears once the fiscal variables used in the literature are scaled by the proper factor.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了边际累积乘数的概念——即在保持另一财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响——并将其应用于一个涵盖1978年至2020年间16个国家财政整顿事件的知名面板数据集。在我们的基准设定中，估计两年期的边际支出乘数为1.5，而边际税收乘数接近于0。我们还通过应用McKay和Wolf（2023）的政策反事实方法估计了类似的乘数。在广泛的稳健性分析中，我们从未发现支出乘数低于1.3或税收乘数高于-1的情况。这些发现似乎与现有财政乘数文献中的多数结论相悖，后者通常发现税收乘数高于支出乘数。我们表明，一旦文献中使用的财政变量按适当因子进行缩放，这一矛盾便消失。
title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
title_zh: 征税还是削减？财政整顿中的边际税收与支出乘数

abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个全球经济的总体均衡模型，该模型将产品市场中竞争的异质性企业与在全球范围内配置资本的国家相结合。通过将产品侧的享乐需求系统与资产侧的均值-方差投资组合系统相结合，我们得到了模型均衡的近似闭式解。我们利用企业层面的资产负债表数据、收入和就业的地理分布数据以及业务描述，结合国家层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，将模型量化应用于48个国家约23,000家上市公司的横截面数据。我们运用该模型评估全球化带来的重新配置和福利效应。金融和贸易自由化均将活动集中于规模最大的企业并提升福利，其中新兴经济体和中型开放经济体分别获得更大的收益。产品市场和资本市场的摩擦相互放大，这意味着对其中一个市场的自由化会减少另一个市场自由化的收益。
title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
title_zh: 全球企业与资本市场模型

abstract: Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.
abstract_zh: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率均有所下降。人们也报告称希望生育更少的孩子：在2012年至2022年间，理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，而在相近时期内，表示三年内有意生育孩子的受访者比例从28%降至21%。原因何在？利用两项跨国调查，这些调查询问受访者的态度及生育偏好，且每项调查均相隔约十年进行两次，我们将每次下降分解为一系列广泛且相互竞争的态度所贡献的部分。其中三项态度尤为突出：孩子日益被视为妨碍父母自由的因素；对于年幼孩子的母亲是否应工作的看法已显著变得更加进步，并在高等教育程度群体中占据了下降份额的更大比例；以及越来越少的人认为女性或男性需要孩子才能过上充实的生活。最后一种态度在十年间变化最大，并且是导致预期生育率下降的最大贡献因素，尤其是在教育程度较低的女性中。家务分工的变化及工作与家庭冲突的加剧对生育偏好变化的影响较小。
title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
title_zh: 生育率下降：自由、自我实现与家庭价值的变迁

abstract: American colleges and universities are highly stratified by pre-college academic achievement, family background, and institutional resources. We study the meritocratic consensus in American higher education: colleges that high-testing students (who are generally also from high-income families) attend spend dramatically more on instruction than do those that enroll lower-testing students. Stratification by test scores has been largely stable since the 1960s, but the stratification of instructional resources has risen sharply since 1970 at both private and public institutions. Non-academic admissions criteria like athletics, legacy, and affirmative action are second-order in determining the allocation of students to universities. Potential economic justifications for the positive association of instructional expenditures with student prior achievement—q-complementarity between achievement and resources, convex social returns to high human capital, and incentives to invest in learning prior to college—have little empirical support. Resource stratification across universities has not increased in the past decade, largely due to increased public funding of universities that enroll lower-testing students through financial aid programs like California's CalGrant, but stratification within institutions is now rising swiftly.
abstract_zh: 美国高校在入学前的学业成就、家庭背景及院校资源方面高度分层。我们研究了美国高等教育中的精英主义共识：高分学生（通常也来自高收入家庭）所就读的大学在教学上的支出远高于录取低分学生的院校。自1960年代以来，按考试成绩的分层大体保持稳定，但自1970年以来，私立和公立院校中教学资源的分层急剧加剧。非学术录取标准，如体育特长、校友子女偏好及平权行动，在学生分配到大学的过程中属于次要因素。教学支出与学生先前成就正相关的潜在经济理由——成就与资源之间的q互补性、高人力资本的社会回报凸性以及大学前学习投资的激励——缺乏实证支持。过去十年间，大学间的资源分层并未加剧，这主要归因于通过如加利福尼亚州的CalGrant等财政援助项目，增加了对录取低分学生大学的公共资助，但院校内部的分层如今正在迅速上升。
title: The Meritocratic Consensus and Stratification in Higher Education
title_zh: 精英共识与高等教育分层

abstract: Childcare services can offer an opportunity for women to develop their careers and increase household income. At the same time, it can affect the development of children, depending on the quality of care. We first develop a collective model of the household as a conceptual framework to show how improving the availability of childcare can affect mothers’ labor market opportunities and earnings and how it can affect child development. We then review the literature on the effects of childcare on the employment and earnings of women and on child development. Childcare can increase mothers’ employment. However, limited work opportunities or strict norms against maternal work can keep mothers out of the labor force. When other family members provide care, childcare can free these caregivers to work or attend school. When studies measure the impact on child development, the results are mixed and depend on both context and quality of provision.
abstract_zh: 育儿服务能为女性提供发展职业生涯和增加家庭收入的机会。同时，根据照护质量的不同，它也可能影响儿童的发展。我们首先构建了一个家庭集体模型作为概念框架，用以说明改善育儿服务的可及性如何影响母亲的劳动力市场机会和收入，以及如何影响儿童发展。随后，我们回顾了关于育儿服务对女性就业、收入及儿童发展影响的文献。育儿服务可以提高母亲的就业率。然而，有限的工作机会或对母亲就业的严格社会规范可能使母亲留在劳动力市场之外。当其他家庭成员提供照护时，育儿服务可以解放这些照护者，使其能够工作或上学。在衡量对儿童发展影响的研究中，结果不一，且取决于具体情境和服务的质量。
title: The Effect of Childcare on Female Labor Supply and Child Development in Low and Middle Income Countries
title_zh: 中低收入国家儿童保育对女性劳动供给和儿童发展的影响

abstract: Buprenorphine prescribing for opioid use disorder remains far below the scale of the overdose crisis. We estimate the causal effect of county-level synthetic opioid overdose mortality shocks on the volume of buprenorphine treatment delivered, exploiting the staggered geographic diffusion of synthetic opioids from 2013 to 2023. Linking IQVIA Longitudinal Prescription Claims to National Vital Statistics System mortality records, we implement a difference-in-differences estimator with propensity score matching under three complementary exposure measures. Treatment volume increases significantly under all three definitions, with no evidence of differential pre-trends; point estimates for buprenorphine prescribing rates range from 5 to 17 percent of pre-treatment means, emerge within one to two quarters, and grow monotonically thereafter. Our design does not separately identify changes in patient demand and provider behavior, but the increase in unique prescribers is consistent with a provider-side response. The response is concentrated among advanced practice providers, Medicaid patients, and counties with pre-existing buprenorphine infrastructure; counties with little baseline prescribing show no response. Local mortality information acts as a determinant of treatment volume, with effects comparable in magnitude to major legislative interventions aimed at expanding treatment, but appear only where prescribing capacity already exists.
abstract_zh: 阿片类药物使用障碍的丁丙诺啡处方量仍远低于药物过量危机的规模。我们估算了县级合成阿片类药物过量死亡率冲击对丁丙诺啡治疗量的因果效应，利用2013年至2023年合成阿片类药物在地理上的交错扩散。将IQVIA纵向处方索赔数据与国家生命统计系统死亡率记录相链接，我们在三种互补暴露度量下实施带有倾向得分匹配的双重差分估计。在三种定义下，治疗量均显著增加，且无差异化前趋势的证据；丁丙诺啡处方率的点估计值介于治疗前均值的5%至17%之间，在一至两个季度内显现，此后单调增长。我们的设计无法分别识别患者需求与提供者行为的变化，但独特处方提供者数量的增加与供给侧响应一致。该响应集中于高级执业提供者、医疗补助患者以及已有丁丙诺啡基础设施的县；基线处方量较低的县未显示响应。地方死亡率信息作为治疗量的决定因素，其效应在量级上与旨在扩大治疗的主要立法干预相当，但仅在已有处方能力的地区显现。
title: Do Local Synthetic Opioid Overdose Deaths Affect Provider Prescribing of Buprenorphine?
title_zh: 地方合成阿片类药物过量死亡是否影响医生丁丙诺啡处方行为？

abstract: We develop stress tests based on an original International Monetary System (IMS) model with regime switchings. The model is calibrated for nine reference currencies from the beginning of the Classical Gold Standard to the present. Regime switchings in currency dominance are related to combinations of conditions on a multidimensional environment variable that includes five classes of shocks: technology; development; monetary, financial and fiscal institutions; democracy and conflicts; and the regulatory environment. We provide an original database of events for these five classes of shocks, which is used for calibration. The calibration highlights the important role of the democracy and conflicts component in regime switchings. The calibrated model is then used to perform stress tests on the current prospects of currency dominance for a broad set of scenarios. A salient result from the scenarios we tested is that the dominance of the US dollar is at most marginally affected. No other currency emerges as a major player, suggesting strong inertia in the system’s current centripetal dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们基于一个包含制度切换的原创国际货币体系（IMS）模型开发了压力测试。该模型针对从古典金本位制初期至今的九种参考货币进行了校准。货币主导地位中的制度切换与一个多维环境变量的条件组合相关，该变量涵盖五类冲击：技术；发展；货币、金融和财政制度；民主与冲突；以及监管环境。我们为这五类冲击提供了一个原创的事件数据库，用于校准。校准结果凸显了民主与冲突成分在制度切换中的重要作用。随后，校准后的模型被用于对广泛情景下当前货币主导地位前景进行压力测试。我们测试的情景中一个显著结果是，美元的主导地位至多受到轻微影响。没有其他货币成为主要参与者，这表明系统当前向心动态中存在强烈的惯性。
title: Currency Dominance Is Not Forever: Some Insights from a Non-Linear Dynamic Model
title_zh: 货币主导地位并非永恒：来自非线性动态模型的一些启示

abstract: The diffusion of technological innovation depends on incentives, regulations, and firms’ strategic behaviors. We study these intersections within cardiac procedure markets following Medicare’s expansion of non-hospital facility options for treatment, enabled by clinical advancements. State-level regulations restrain federal pro-competition policy. Where market entry occurs, business stealing is concentrated among the lowest cost treatment settings, rather than high-cost hospitals––increasing Medicare spending by approximately $2.5 million. Medicare policy also generates externalities for untargeted procedures and other payers, except when hospitals and physicians are vertically integrated. Federal rulemaking interacts with and is mitigated by complex market dynamics––including in potentially unanticipated ways.
abstract_zh: 技术创新扩散取决于激励、监管及企业战略行为。我们研究了在临床进步推动下，医疗保险扩大非医院设施治疗选择后，心脏手术市场中的这些交叉因素。州级监管限制了联邦促进竞争政策。在市场准入发生之处，业务抢夺集中于成本最低的治疗环境，而非高成本医院——导致医疗保险支出增加约250万美元。医疗保险政策还对未涉及的手术及其他支付方产生外部效应，除非医院与医生实现纵向整合。联邦规则制定与复杂市场动态相互作用，并受其缓和——包括可能以未预见的方式。
title: Stress Testing Cardiac Care Markets through Deregulation
title_zh: 通过放松管制对心脏护理市场进行压力测试

abstract: Support for populist and authoritarian regimes is rising worldwide, despite evidence that they tend to underperform economically. We examine the role of (mis)perceptions of regime performance as drivers of political attitudes, leveraging two survey experiments with 11,377 respondents during Argentina’s 2023 presidential elections. Optimistic beliefs about the performance of populist and non-democratic regimes were widespread, and displayed a strong correlation with support for these regimes. When exposed to randomly assigned informational treatments challenging optimistic views about these political regimes, individuals significantly adjusted their beliefs, and reduced their support for candidates they associate with populist and authoritarian leanings. Exploring the impact of different information sources, we find that academic sources and newspapers were more influential than social media. Although individuals adjusted their beliefs and attitudes in response to information on regime performance, contradicting their prior beliefs reduced their demand for additional information, consistent with an important role for motivated reasoning.
abstract_zh: 尽管有证据表明民粹主义和威权政权往往在经济上表现不佳，但全球范围内对其支持率仍在上升。我们通过阿根廷2023年总统选举期间对11,377名受访者进行的两项调查实验，考察了（错误）认知对政权表现作为政治态度驱动因素的作用。关于民粹主义和非民主政权表现的乐观信念普遍存在，并与对这些政权的支持显示出强烈相关性。当接触到随机分配的信息干预，挑战对这些政治政权表现的乐观看法时，个体显著调整了其信念，并减少了对他们与民粹主义和威权倾向相关联的候选人的支持。通过探索不同信息来源的影响，我们发现学术来源和报纸比社交媒体更具影响力。尽管个体根据政权表现的信息调整了其信念和态度，但与其先前信念相矛盾的信息减少了他们对额外信息的需求，这与动机性推理的重要作用相一致。
title: Where the Grass Seems Greener: Economic Misperceptions and Support for Democracy
title_zh: 草更绿之处：经济误解与民主支持

abstract: Survival analysis methods are often used to predict the time until the onset of an event in settings when the true time-to-event (TTE) may be censored during training. Such approaches typically assume uncensored data are representative of censored data and that the probability of censoring conditioned on the covariates remains constant over time, i.e., there is no censoring distribution shift. However, both assumptions can fail in practice when censoring results from interventions targeted to individuals with particular comorbidities or genetic markers (such as prophylactic surgery when predicting time to cancer onset, or scheduled cesarean delivery and induction when predicting time to spontaneous labor) and changes in clinical policies alter which individuals are targeted for these interventions over time. To address this, we propose a new approach, cluster-weighted inference of time-to event (CWITE), that remains accurate when these assumptions do not hold. Unlike existing approaches that ignore times-to-censoring (TTC) or treat them only as a lower bound of the TTE, CWITE leverages the insight that a subset of censored individuals are likely censored close to their true TTEs, and uses a novel mechanism to learn from such individuals. On the task of predicting time to spontaneous labor using real-world data, CWITE improves TTE accuracy for individuals similar to censored training data (mean absolute error: 6.50 days, 95% CI: [5.55, 7.40] vs. 7.82 days, [6.82, 8.82]) while maintaining comparable performance for those similar to uncensored training data (6.50 days, [5.54, 7.61] vs. 6.63 days, [5.67,7.69]). Our results demonstrate that incorporating more specific supervision from censored training data can significantly improve TTE predictions in settings with limited overlap and censoring distribution shift, challenges common in real-world clinical data. Code to implement CWITE and reproduce all experiments in the paper is available at https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE.
abstract_zh: 生存分析方法常用于预测事件发生前的时间，在训练过程中真实事件发生时间（TTE）可能被审查的情况下。这类方法通常假设未审查数据能代表审查数据，并且给定协变量时审查概率随时间保持不变，即不存在审查分布偏移。然而，在实践中，当审查源于针对具有特定合并症或遗传标记个体的干预措施（如预测癌症发病时间时的预防性手术，或预测自然分娩时间时的计划剖宫产和引产）以及临床政策随时间变化导致针对这些干预措施的个体目标改变时，这两个假设都可能失效。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新方法，即聚类加权事件时间推断（CWITE），该方法在这些假设不成立时仍能保持准确性。与现有方法忽略审查时间（TTC）或仅将其视为TTE的下界不同，CWITE利用了一个洞察：一部分被审查的个体可能在其真实TTE附近被审查，并通过一种新颖机制从这些个体中学习。在利用真实世界数据预测自然分娩时间的任务中，CWITE提高了与审查训练数据相似个体的TTE预测准确性（平均绝对误差：6.50天，95%置信区间：[5.55, 7.40]对比7.82天，[6.82, 8.82]），同时在与未审查训练数据相似个体上保持了相当的性能（6.50天，[5.54, 7.61]对比6.63天，[5.67, 7.69]）。我们的结果表明，在重叠有限和审查分布偏移的情况下，从审查训练数据中融入更具体的监督信息能显著改善TTE预测，这些挑战在真实临床数据中常见。实现CWITE并复现论文中所有实验的代码可在https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE获取。
title: Survival Analysis with Limited Overlap and Censoring Distribution Shift
title_zh: 有限重叠与删失分布偏移下的生存分析

abstract: The possibility of fiscal dominance in the representative-agent New Keynesian model (RANK) hinges on the assumption that income is perpetually demand-determined: fiscal deficits can drive output and inflation within that model only insofar as they trigger infinitely lasting, self-sustained shifts in aggregate spending and income. Moving to heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian models (HANK) opens the door to a different pathway: classical non-Ricardian effects, due to finite horizons or liquidity constraints. A refinement motivated by the model's intended focus on short-run phenomena—requiring a return to flexible-price outcomes in finite time—arrests the infinite feedback loop between spending and income, leaving only the classical non-Ricardian mechanism, and makes sure that the study of monetary-fiscal interactions is not centered on hard-to-test assumptions regarding beliefs at infinity.
abstract_zh: 在代表性主体新凯恩斯模型（RANK）中，财政主导的可能性取决于收入永久由需求决定的假设：在该模型内，财政赤字只有在引发总支出和收入无限期持续、自我维持的变动时，才能推动产出和通胀。转向异质性主体新凯恩斯模型（HANK）则开辟了一条不同的路径：由于有限视野或流动性约束导致的经典非李嘉图效应。基于模型旨在聚焦短期现象——要求在有限时间内回归弹性价格结果——的细化，阻断了支出与收入之间的无限反馈循环，仅保留经典非李嘉图机制，并确保货币-财政相互作用的研究不依赖于关于无穷远处信念的难以检验的假设。
title: Monetary-Fiscal Interactions: A Reappraisal
title_zh: 货币-财政互动：再评估

abstract: Public AI benchmarks steer research and allocate investments. They are therefore market designs. Public examples can reveal the process behind a private final test, while a finite public score cannot cover a broad task space inherent to general intelligence. I show how both gaps become profitable when scores move capital and how targeted effort erodes the signal used by later investors. The market design lesson is to separate development from certification: publish practice tasks, but choose the investment-consequential generator after the submitted system's evaluation policy is fixed.
abstract_zh: 公共人工智能基准引导研究方向并分配投资，因此它们属于市场设计。公开示例能揭示私人最终测试背后的过程，而有限的公开分数无法覆盖通用智能固有的广泛任务空间。我展示了当分数驱动资本流动时，这两个缺口如何变得有利可图，以及针对性努力如何侵蚀后续投资者所使用的信号。市场设计的启示在于将开发与认证分离：发布练习任务，但在提交系统的评估策略固定之后，再选择对投资具有决定性影响的生成器。
title: Benchmark Mineability and the Financing of AI Innovation
title_zh: 基准可开采性与人工智能创新的融资

abstract: How do firms set wages? How should governments set income taxes? If labor supply is inelastic to wages, firms can pay workers less than their marginal products, and governments can increase taxes without eroding the base. However, the structure of labor supply elasticities in the economy is complex. Recent empirics document variation across workers, firms, and margins (which firm to work at versus how many hours to work). To account for this rich structure of labor supply elasticities we extend the neoclassical model to include a discrete choice over which firm to work at, production complementarities and strategic interaction between heterogeneous, granular firms. In terms of wage setting, we find that novel effects of worker heterogeneity account for 78 percent of the variable component of labor supply elasticities and markdowns, and 89 percent of markdown differences between large and small firms. In terms of policy, higher progressivity makes labor supply less elastic, eroding the tax base by widening markdowns and worsening sorting. These channels (i) produce large declines in earnings following increases in marginal tax rates, consistent with empirical studies, and (ii) reduce optimal tax progressivity by one-third and associated welfare gains by two-thirds.
abstract_zh: 企业如何设定工资？政府应如何设定所得税？如果劳动力供给对工资缺乏弹性，企业可以支付低于其边际产出的工资，政府也可以在不侵蚀税基的情况下提高税收。然而，经济中劳动力供给弹性的结构十分复杂。近期实证研究记录了工人、企业以及不同边际（选择在哪家企业工作与选择工作多少小时）之间的差异。为解释劳动力供给弹性这一丰富结构，我们扩展了新古典模型，纳入对工作企业的离散选择、生产互补性以及异质性、颗粒型企业之间的战略互动。在工资设定方面，我们发现工人异质性的新效应解释了劳动力供给弹性和加价折价（markdowns）可变部分的78%，以及大企业与小企业之间加价折价差异的89%。在政策方面，更高的累进性使劳动力供给弹性降低，通过扩大加价折价和恶化匹配（sorting）侵蚀税基。这些渠道（i）导致边际税率提高后收入大幅下降，与实证研究一致；（ii）使最优税收累进性降低三分之一，相关福利收益减少三分之二。
title: Labor Market Power with Worker and Firm Heterogeneity
title_zh: 具有工人与企业异质性的劳动力市场势力

abstract: We examine how contractions in local labor demand during the Great Recession affected children's academic achievement. We combine county-level test scores for grades 3–8 from the Stanford Education Data Archive with a shift-share design that interacts counties' 2005 industry composition with national industry employment growth, isolating demand-driven changes in local employment. Following recent advances in the shift-share literature, we validate the design with balance, pre-trend, and Rotemberg-weight diagnostics and report exposure-robust standard errors throughout. A one-standard-deviation adverse shock lowers mathematics achievement by about 0.03 student-level standard deviations and widens the White–Black and economic-disadvantage achievement gaps in both subjects. Within a common geography, losses concentrate among economically disadvantaged students. English language arts estimates point in the same direction but are harder to separate from the Great Recession's housing bust, and we interpret them as the combined effect of the labor-demand contraction and the associated decline in house prices. The achievement response is concentrated in the recession window. The post-2014 period, identified mainly by the oil-price cycle, yields a precise null, so our estimates measure the response to severe contractions rather than a general business-cycle parameter. School funding did not respond contemporaneously to these shocks, while family income, child poverty, and house prices all did.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了大衰退期间地方劳动力需求收缩对儿童学业成绩的影响。我们将斯坦福教育数据档案中3至8年级的县级考试成绩与一种“份额-转移”设计相结合，该设计将各县2005年的产业结构与全国行业就业增长进行交互，从而分离出地方就业中由需求驱动的变化。遵循份额-转移文献的最新进展，我们通过平衡性检验、事前趋势检验和Rotemberg权重诊断来验证该设计的有效性，并在全文中报告暴露稳健的标准误。一个标准差的不利冲击会使数学成绩降低约0.03个学生层面标准差，并扩大白人与黑人之间以及经济弱势群体之间的成绩差距，且这一效应在数学和英语两科中均存在。在共同的地理范围内，损失集中于经济弱势学生群体。英语语言艺术的估计结果指向相同方向，但难以与大衰退时期的房地产泡沫破裂相区分，因此我们将其解释为劳动力需求收缩及相关房价下跌的联合效应。学业成绩的响应集中出现在衰退窗口期内。2014年之后，主要由油价周期识别的时期产生了精确的零效应，因此我们的估计衡量的是对严重收缩的响应，而非一般性的商业周期参数。学校经费对这些冲击没有即时响应，而家庭收入、儿童贫困率和房价均有所反应。
title: Local Labor Demand and Achievement Gaps: Evidence from the Great Recession
title_zh: 地方劳动力需求与学业成就差距：来自大衰退的证据

abstract: How slow are bank transfers, and how do transfer delays affect deposit demand? Using transaction-level data from millions of depositors, we measure transfer delays by matching debits and credits across accounts held by the same depositor. Shorter delays correlate with more transfers and lower balances. Exploiting county-level exposure to Zelle’s staggered rollout, we find that faster payments reduce delays and deposit growth. Calibrating a deposit-management model, we find that transfer delays raise deposit demand, and the magnitude of this effect varies with interest rates and consumption volatility. Payment frictions therefore shape transactional deposit demand and monetary transmission.
abstract_zh: 银行转账有多慢，转账延迟又如何影响存款需求？利用数百万储户的交易级数据，我们通过匹配同一储户账户间的借方与贷方来度量转账延迟。较短的延迟与更多的转账次数和更低的账户余额相关联。利用县级对Zelle分阶段推出的暴露度，我们发现更快的支付减少了延迟并降低了存款增长。校准一个存款管理模型后，我们发现转账延迟提高了存款需求，且这一效应的大小随利率和消费波动性而变化。因此，支付摩擦塑造了交易性存款需求和货币传导机制。
title: Tracing the Impact of Payment Convenience on Deposits: Evidence from Depositor Activeness
title_zh: 支付便利性对存款的影响追踪：来自存款人活跃度的证据

abstract: I decompose stock returns into a duration-matched Treasury component, identified from monetary policy surprises, and a payoff component. Risk and returns rise much less with duration for stocks than for their matched Treasuries. Stock volatility is dampened by rate insurance: rates fall in bad times, so the bond inside a stock provides insurance against the stock’s payoff risk. Expected stock returns are dampened because the insurance works in reverse: rates rise in good times, so stocks’ payoff gains hedge the losses borne by investors holding net duration, notably government bonds when Ricardian equivalence fails. This framework helps reconcile positive bond premia with negative stock-bond covariance, sheds light on equity anomalies and the collapse of the value premium, implies that fiscal and monetary policy shape bond and equity premia, and motivates a two-factor model that jointly prices stocks and bonds. Rate insurance can even turn the price of long-run risk negative, explaining why long bonds beat long stocks.
abstract_zh: 我将股票收益分解为期限匹配的国债成分（通过货币政策冲击识别）与支付成分。股票的风险和收益随期限上升的幅度远低于其匹配国债。股票波动性受到利率保险的抑制：利率在经济低迷时下降，因此股票内部的债券成分对股票的支付风险提供了保险。预期股票收益受到抑制，因为保险机制反向运作：利率在经济繁荣时上升，因此股票的支付收益对冲了投资者持有净期限敞口（尤其是当李嘉图等价失效时政府债券）所承受的损失。这一框架有助于调和正债券溢价与负股票-债券协方差，揭示股票异象及价值溢价的崩溃，表明财政与货币政策塑造债券和股票溢价，并推动了一个联合定价股票和债券的双因子模型。利率保险甚至能使长期风险的价格转为负值，从而解释长期债券跑赢长期股票的现象。
title: Rate Risk and Rate Insurance
title_zh: 利率风险与利率保险

abstract: We examine whether occupational licensing improves service quality and safety using trip-level Uber data that include driver ratings and telematics-based measures of driving behavior. Exploiting quasi-random assignment from proximity-based dispatch, we compare trips served by licensed and unlicensed drivers in two settings: a cross-border comparison between New York City and New Jersey, and a deregulation event in Houston. Across settings and specifications, including instrumental variable estimates, we find no consistent evidence that licensing improves consumer outcomes. In Houston, post-deregulation entrants are indistinguishable from previously licensed drivers on ratings and driving behavior, despite differing markedly in experience and age.
abstract_zh: 我们利用包含司机评分和基于远程信息处理的驾驶行为指标的Uber行程级数据，考察职业许可是否提升服务质量和安全性。借助基于邻近调度的准随机分配，我们在两种情境下比较持牌与无牌司机服务的行程：纽约市与新泽西州的跨境对比，以及休斯顿的放松管制事件。跨情境和规格（包括工具变量估计）中，我们发现没有一致证据表明许可改善消费者结果。在休斯顿，放松管制后进入者与先前持牌司机在评分和驾驶行为上难以区分，尽管他们在经验和年龄上差异显著。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国纽约、新泽西和休斯顿的Uber司机，数据与制度背景均非中国。
title: Occupational Licensing of Uber Drivers
title_zh: 优步司机的职业许可制度

abstract: We design a method for measuring the risk preferences of agents in the deep past. The method combines a structural model of crop choice as a portfolio allocation with machine-learning prediction of expected crop returns, using historic agronomic and climate data. We estimate county-level risk preferences for the United States and farmer-level preferences in Kansas from 1889 to 1929. More risk averse farmers leveraged less, were less likely to purchase novel WWI Liberty Bonds, and were more likely to participate in local risk-sharing institutions. We show that higher risk aversion predicts slower tractor adoption and farm mechanization during the 1920s.
abstract_zh: 我们设计了一种衡量远古时期个体风险偏好的方法。该方法将作物选择的结构性模型视为投资组合配置，并结合机器学习预测预期作物收益，利用历史农业与气候数据。我们估算了美国县级风险偏好及1889年至1929年间堪萨斯州农民个体层面的偏好。风险规避程度更高的农民杠杆使用较少，购买一战新型自由债券的可能性较低，而更倾向于参与本地风险分担机制。我们证明，更高的风险规避程度预示着20世纪20年代拖拉机采用及农业机械化进程的放缓。
title: The Yeoman's Portfolio: Measuring Historical Risk Preferences Using Crop Choice
title_zh: 《自耕农的投资组合：利用作物选择衡量历史风险偏好》

abstract: Urban development boundaries (UDBs) have been introduced in China’s territorial spatial planning system as a key tool to regulate urban expansion. However, existing research has paid limited attention to how land development rights are negotiated and exercised among multiple stakeholders under UDBs, from delineation to implementation. We develop a two-stage game model to explain the UDB policy, using the Pearl River Delta (PRD) urban agglomeration as a simulation case. In the first stage, a principal–agent model is applied to examine how land development rights are allocated through negotiations between superior and subordinate governments. In the second stage, an evolutionary game model is used to analyze the strategic interactions among governments and developers regarding land development rights under UDBs. Simulation results indicate that during delineation, higher land values and stronger bargaining capacity improve efforts to obtain quotas, whereas greater external volatility and heavier protection tasks reduce these efforts. During implementation, stakeholders’ strategies are linked with land quota scarcity in the first stage. In a quota-abundant scenario, the system converges to the optimal evolutionarily stable strategy (ESS) of strict supervision, prohibition, and compliance. In a quota-scarce scenario, achieving the optimal ESS becomes more difficult, requiring an effective penalty and strict accountability for subordinate governments. Overall, the proposed two-stage game framework provides a numerical illustration that captures the behavioral dynamics of multiple stakeholders and provides practical insights to strengthen the enforcement of UDBs.
abstract_zh: 城市开发边界（UDBs）已被引入中国国土空间规划体系，作为调控城市扩张的关键工具。然而，现有研究对UDBs下从划定到实施过程中，多元利益主体之间土地发展权的协商与行使关注有限。我们构建了一个两阶段博弈模型来解释UDB政策，并以珠江三角洲（PRD）城市群作为模拟案例。第一阶段，运用委托—代理模型考察上级与下级政府之间通过协商分配土地发展权的过程。第二阶段，采用演化博弈模型分析UDBs下政府与开发商之间围绕土地发展权的策略互动。模拟结果表明，在划定阶段，较高的土地价值和更强的谈判能力会提升获取配额的积极性，而更大的外部波动性和更重的保护任务则会降低这种积极性。在实施阶段，各利益主体的策略与第一阶段的土地配额稀缺性相关联。在配额充裕的情景下，系统收敛于严格监管、禁止和合规的最优演化稳定策略（ESS）。在配额稀缺的情景下，实现最优ESS变得更加困难，需要有效的惩罚措施和对下级政府的严格问责。总体而言，所提出的两阶段博弈框架提供了一个数值示例，捕捉了多元利益主体的行为动态，并为加强UDBs的执行提供了实践启示。
china_relevance_reason: AI 倾向判定为中国相关，但题名/摘要/元数据缺少直接中国证据，已按保守规则排除
title: From delineation to implementation of urban development boundaries: A two-stage game of land development rights
title_zh: 城市开发边界的划定与实施：土地开发权的两阶段博弈

abstract: The 2024 reform of the EU fiscal framework makes fiscal adjustment more country-specific and less procyclical. However, it does not eliminate two fundamental tail risks: following a large recession, too little fiscal flexibility can generate deflationary stagnation, while too much can undermine confidence in national debt stabilisation and generate stagflation. This column shows that a Eurobond-financed common fiscal capacity can mitigate both tail risks. Under this proposal, stabilisation of exceptional common shocks is shifted to the euro-area level while responsibility for national debt remains firmly national.
abstract_zh: 2024年欧盟财政框架改革使财政调整更具国别针对性，且减少顺周期性。然而，改革并未消除两大根本性尾部风险：在严重衰退之后，财政灵活性不足可能引发通缩性停滞，而灵活性过度则可能削弱对国家债务稳定的信心，并导致滞胀。本文专栏指出，由欧元债券融资的共同财政能力可同时缓解这两种尾部风险。在该提议下，异常共同冲击的稳定职能被转移至欧元区层面，而国家债务的责任仍牢牢保留在国家层面。
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Qingyuan Fang, Leonardo Melosi, Anna Rogantini Picco
title: Why Europe needs Eurobonds
title_zh: 欧洲为何需要欧元债券

abstract: Governments around the world are increasingly mandating the digitalisation of business records, yet little is known about the effects of these policies beyond tax compliance. This column discusses how mandatory electronic invoicing reshapes credit markets by changing the information available to lenders. The evidence shows that eInvoicing reallocates credit toward firms that already rely on invoice-based financing and away from other firms, as banks become better at assessing the credit risk of the former relative to the latter.
abstract_zh: 世界各国政府日益强制推行商业记录数字化，然而，除税收合规外，这些政策的影响鲜为人知。本文探讨了强制电子发票如何通过改变贷款方可获取的信息来重塑信贷市场。证据表明，电子发票将信贷重新配置给已依赖发票融资的企业，而减少对其他企业的信贷，因为银行在评估前者相对于后者的信用风险方面变得更加擅长。
authors: Alejandro Casado, Marco Giometti, Jose Gutierrez, David Martinez-Miera, Alexandra Matyunina, Tammaro Terracciano
title: Digitalisation and credit markets: Evidence from eInvoicing
title_zh: 数字化与信贷市场：来自电子发票的证据

abstract: I propose a novel method to reliably estimate the conditional pricing kernel by incorporating conditioning variables. The VIX and the term spread are most informative variables for identifying state prices. The conditional kernel estimate exhibits significant time variation: the more favorable market expectations, the higher state prices in negative return states. During bad times, the equity premium implied by the conditional kernel is fully attributable to compensation for left-tail scenarios, in contrast to findings from the unconditional kernel. Lastly, the conditional kernel estimate yields superior out-of-sample option pricing performance compared to the unconditional kernel estimate.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，通过纳入条件变量来可靠估计条件定价核。VIX和期限利差是识别状态价格最具信息量的变量。条件核估计显示出显著的时间变化性：市场预期越乐观，负收益状态下的状态价格越高。在不利时期，条件核隐含的股权溢价完全归因于左尾情景的补偿，这与无条件核的发现形成对比。最后，与无条件核估计相比，条件核估计在样本外期权定价表现上更为优越。
title: Characterizing the Conditional Pricing Kernel: A New Approach
title_zh: 刻画条件定价核：一种新方法
